about: Names for golf.exe v1.02 game state at its original addresses (the port keeps every global there). Read and written live by the game bridge (docs/BRIDGE.md). value = raw * scale + offset; 'bit' picks one bit of the raw value; 'compute' entries are decoded by tools/mcp/simgolf/lib/symbols.js. confidence: high = read in the decompile and checked live through the bridge, medium = decompile or upstream docs only, low = a guess.
sources: build/gen/golf (Ghidra decompile, file:line below), upstream/simgolf-native/docs, live checks through the bridge (task-13)

money.notes: Cash in units of $100 (raw 10000 = $1,000,000). Standard games start at 1000, Sandbox at 10000 and hides the money panel. Top bar draws raw*100, red when negative.
money.source: golf_02.c:14469 FUN_0042dc00(DAT_00571fd4*100); golf_01.c:22215 top bar; live: 10000 after a new Sandbox game

money_raw.notes: The cash global as stored ($100 units).

tick.notes: Game clock, one tick per course frame while unpaused (about 11 per second at normal pace). 1024 ticks per month (about 34 per day), 8 months a year (March to October).
tick.source: FUN_0040d7b0 golf_01.c:11121; saved at golf_01.c:8794; live: +1 per frame, frozen while the bridge pauses

date.notes: Decoded from tick: year 2001 + (tick>>13), month March..October from (tick>>10)&7, day ((tick&1023)*30>>10)+1. Matches the 'March 2001' banner of a new game.

game_flags.notes: Bit mask: 0x4 paused (in-game pause button), 0x8 fast mode, 0x1000000 sandbox, 0x2000000 reactions off, 0x4000000 tutorial/championship.

paused_in_game.notes: The game's own pause (the pause button). Not the bridge's pause, which freezes the whole game loop.

sandbox.notes: 1 in Sandbox mode (set with cash 100000, unlock 0x11, difficulty 1).
sandbox.source: golf_01.c:15237; live: set after Sandbox Mode

fast_mode_flag.notes: Fast mode bit (tick rounded to even).

fast_hud.notes: Non-zero shows 'Fast' in the HUD, skips frame pacing and doubles the golfer walk step. Writer not found in the decompile.

holes_built.notes: Next hole number minus one: holes opened so far (0 to 18).
holes_built.source: init golf_01.c:13429; DECODE_TOURNAMENTS.md:18; live: raw 1 on a new course

hole_par.notes: Par (3, 4 or 5) of each hole record (20 records of 0x208 bytes, first byte of each); 0 = closed. The index is the hole NUMBER: index 0 and 19 are unused (0), holes 1 to 18 sit at indexes 1 to 18. get_state hole_par index=5 is hole 5.
hole_par.source: DECODE_GOLFERCARD.md:41; golf_01.c FUN_004060a0 reads (char)DAT_00575ab0[hole * 0x208]; live: Showcase Resort gives [0,4,4,3,4,4,5,4,3,4,4,3,5,3,5,4,5,4,4,0], sum 72

golfers_on_course.notes: Golfer slots 0..151 (0x100 bytes each) whose hole byte is 1..18. Not a game global: counted from the golfer array.

golfers.notes: Active golfer slots with x, y (+0, +4 i32), hole (+0x21 i8), strokes (+0x22 u8), mood (+0xa4 i16), profile (+0xb6 i16). Field layout from upstream docs.

fun_rating.notes: Fun rating shown in the HUD.

skill_rating.notes: Skill rating shown in the HUD.

stars.notes: Top-left star count = sum of four counters (two recomputed every frame, 0x5787cc fame).

fame.notes: Fame counter, one of the star parts.

dock_mode.notes: Bottom-left dock: 0 Build Course, 1 Add Buildings, 2 Golfers, 3 and 4 Player.

tool_building.notes: Selected building/amenity tool, -1 none: 0 Pathway, 1 Bench, 2 Flower, 3 Ball Washer, 4 Landmark, 5 Home Site, 16 Willow, 19 Bridge.

tool_terrain.notes: Selected terrain brush id, -1 when an elevation tool is selected.

property_index.notes: Current property, index into the 17 property records at 0x571fd8 (stride 0x2e).

course_name_custom.notes: -1 = default name; else an offset into the string pool at 0x56fcb0.

course_name.notes: Custom name from the pool (0x56fcb0 + course_name_custom) or the site default (0x4c1ea8 + 0x82 * byte[0x571ff4 + 0x2e * property_index] + 1).

map_tiles.notes: Tile ids, map_width x map_height, index x*map_width+y (50 x 50 originally; task-8 moves the arrays, the bridge `grid` command knows where, and a symbol with grid:true reads the whole current map).  The ids are the ids of the terrain tools: 0 tee, 1 green, 2 fairway, 3 firm fairway, 4 rough, 5 deep rough, 7 sand trap, 11 brush (others: water, stream, rocks, trees, off-property land; 20 is most of the outside). Flags: symbol tile_flags (i16 per tile, 0x53caf0). Elevation at 0x5a4998, shadow terrain at 0x542414.

map_width.notes: Tiles per map row: tile index = x * map_width + y (map_tiles, tile_flags, tile_screen_x/y use it). 50 in the original; with bigger maps (task-8, map_scale) up to 158. g_map_w is a port global, not a golf.exe address, so the bridge reports it (ping, grid).

map_height.notes: Rows of the map (g_map_h); equals map_width so far.

hover_tile_x.notes: Tile under the pointer, recomputed every frame from the cursor (FUN_00430020). Its y is hover_tile_y. What a tool click would act on.
hover_tile_x.source: golf_01.c:22469 FUN_00430020(x,y,&DAT_00543d08,&DAT_00543d0c); live: equals the camera tile with the pointer on its centre, follows the pointer in the bridge drag test

tile_flags.notes: Per-tile flag bits, index x*map_width+y (same as map_tiles). 0x20 path, 0x40 connected (the path chain reaches the clubhouse), 0x100 bridge, 0x200 bench. Other bits are not decoded yet.
tile_flags.source: DECODE_WORLD2.md; golf_01.c:8776-8780; showcase course build (docs/SHOWCASE.md, task-18); live: Showcase Resort has 500 path, 567 connected, 49 bridge and 19 bench tiles

tile_screen_x.notes: Screen x of the centre of each tile in view (index x*map_width+y), rebuilt every frame by the course renderer; 0 or -99 = not in view. tile_to_screen reads it.

tile_screen_y.notes: Screen y of the centre of each tile in view (index x*map_width+y); same cache as tile_screen_x.

camera_tile_x.notes: Tile (0..49) the course view is centred on. Writing it moves the camera on the next frames (the main loop clamps it); tile_screen_x/y follow.
camera_tile_x.source: task-15 camera controls (docs/PORT_CHANGES.md); task-18 showcase builder; live

debt_strikes.notes: 0 to 3; three negative year ends end the contract.
